title: representative game, other races: seven expert computer players on custom races (WM, SD, IT, JoaT, PP, IS, HE with other LRTs), small dense universe, 2466 to 2477 chained (12 years) with every player's orders

source.experiment: stars-oracle-apparatus evidence/rg004 (private); start from year 2465 of the unrecorded RGF warm-up

cases.setup: year 1 of the chain (NOT from game start. A new game (small, dense, close positions, random events on) of seven custom races, every player made an expert computer player before the first year (setup step, experiments/rg004); 65 years then generated unrecorded with the host planning (the warm-up), and the recorded chain starts from that state. Each recorded year: the computer players planned from the current files, then the year was generated with every order file supplied, so the host ran no computer player and the stream starts at seeding)
cases.verdict: recorded, no prediction committed; samples flagged from 2 other streams
